   59: function getBarbedPortCount(
   60:   structure: string
   61: ) {
   62:   const portCountMap: Record<
   63:     string,
   64:     number
   65:   > = {
   66:     "直通型": 2,
   67:     "L型": 2,

   70:     "π型": 1,

   72:     "倒刺堵头": 1,
   73:   };
   74: 
   75:   return portCountMap[structure] || 3;
   76: }
   77: 
   78: function BarbedPortFilterGroup({
   79:   filterGroups,
   80:   isOptionActive,
   81:   isOptionDisabled,
   82:   onFilterChange,
   83: }: {

   85:     ProductSelectionFilterGroup[];
